ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails on the driver's own trace, and the fee is therefore not chargeable. I do not dispute arrival: the trace does contain qualifying in-radius fixes under POL-NS-02 at the Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd pin (STANDARD class, 50 m arrival radius), 11 consecutive qualifying fixes. But the whole of the driver's in-geofence time is a single continuous run of 95 seconds, from 12:21:22 to 12:22:57 (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run; run_count 1). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec exactly as limb (c) directs, and the derived threshold block for STANDARD agrees at 180 seconds. The required continuous dwell is 85 seconds short, and limb (c) is one of four conjunctive limbs, so the anchor clause is broken.

POL-NS-06 makes that shortfall a strict-liability refund, not a question about the rider's conduct: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the free waiting period in force, the cancellation fee 'is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. Measured dwell 95 seconds against a required 180, shortfall 85 seconds (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec; derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.longest_run_sec 95.0). The fare ledger shows the 4.50 SGD cancellation fee as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The rider is entitled to the whole of that 4.50 SGD back, and because POL-NS-06 awards no driver compensation, none is payable on this trip.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails on timing as well. Limb (c) as drafted runs the dwell clock from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' tap: that fix is stamped 12:21:22, so the 180-second period could not have elapsed before 12:24:22, and the record's own wait_timer_started event at 12:21:24 would not have expired until 12:24:24. The trip record shows the driver terminated the trip at 12:23:01 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW - 99 seconds into the wait, 81 seconds before the free waiting period had run, and on a trip with no boarding event and no start. A termination before the required dwell has elapsed does not satisfy limb (d), so the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is not supported by this record.

The driver cannot rescue the dwell by aggregation. POL-NS-06 limb (i) allows separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic_advisory is present and populated and carries a qualifying type; here EV-ADVIS-03202-01 is MISSING - no advisory covers Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd in this window - and it carries weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. I disclose that impairment expressly: the artifact is at weight 0.0 and can carry no fact, and its absence is itself the point. Limb (i) is unavailable on a MISSING advisory, as the derived arrival block states, and the trace independently shows only one in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to add in any event. The 95-second run is the whole of the driver's in-geofence time.

The chat log shows the driver cancelling while the rider was announcing her position and while he knew where she was. At 12:22:22 the rider sent 'im at the lobby, coming out', read by the driver at 12:22:42; at 12:22:57 the driver himself wrote 'Im in the white car [registration masked] at the lobby' - confirming he was at the pickup point at that moment; four seconds later, at 12:23:01, he terminated the trip, and the rider's read receipt on that message is stamped 12:23:17, after the cancellation. Nothing in the waiting window shows a rider failing to appear; it shows a wait ended with 81 seconds of the free period still to run, which is the premature cancellation POL-NS-06 addresses.

The rider was at the pin, not 'nowhere near my car' as the counterparty statement asserts. Her rider_track carries 41 fixes, all 41 qualifying under the accuracy filter, and every one of them within 18.05 m of the pickup pin (derived.rider_presence.max_distance_m), across the window from 12:18:24 onwards - comfortably inside the 100 m rider-presence radius POL-NS-04 sets for STANDARD class. I do not rely on POL-NS-04 to exonerate the rider: the driver did reply within 120 seconds, at 12:22:37, so limb (b) of that clause is not met and the clause does not apply. The presence fact matters only to the credibility of the driver's account; the fee is decided by the dwell shortfall regardless of rider presence.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so this case should be decided on the record rather than held: escalation holds the fee rather than refunding it, and would leave the rider out of pocket on a charge the record shows was premature. On limb (c), rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so the two-or-more-same-pair test is not met. On limb (d), rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, not 3 or more, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the absolute count of 4) and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 62 is 1.6 percent (below 8 percent) - both limbs are required and neither holds. Limb (e) is not in play either: the deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-03202 and EV-TRIP-03202, both COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap stays at 1.0, above the 0.70 floor.

The remedy is FULL_REFUND of the whole contested 4.50 SGD to the rider, who is the filing party on this dispute, and POL-GEN-03 defines that value as the filing party being entirely right with the whole contested amount returned. POL-NS-06 confines the refund to the cancellation-fee line, and that is the only live line on this ledger: base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare, platform_fee, tolls_erp, airport_surcharge and waiting_time_fee are all 0.00, with total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. A waiting-time fee could not be claimed here in any case, since POL-NS-10(d) permits one only on a completed trip, and this trip was never started. The monetary effect of 4.50 SGD is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

EV-GPS-03202 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius on 11 consecutive fixes at the trace's 10 second cadence, beginning at 12:21:22 and running to 12:22:57, with 100% coverage and no gaps, and 12:21:22 is also the timestamp of the driver's 'I'm Here' event in EV-TRIP-03202; POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b), read through POL-NS-02, are therefore satisfied and the rider's suggestion that the driver was not there cannot stand.

The arrival marker was not a false marker under POL-NS-05: the fix at the arrival event's own timestamp is the first qualifying in-geofence fix, 50 m or less from the pin (so the 'more than 300 m' limb is plainly not met), and the derived dwell runs from that same fix with dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, so the waiting clock was not recomputed, the arrival time stands at 12:21:22, and no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) can be entered against this driver.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied and the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is truthful: EV-TRIP-03202 records no boarding event and a driver termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, and the rider's own message at 12:22:22 says only that he is 'coming out', while his device records 41 fixes, every one stationary, all between 10.88 m and 18.04 m from the pin - on his own track the rider had not reached the kerb when the driver cancelled.

The rider cannot re-route this dispute through POL-NS-03: that clause addresses a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, whereas here the driver's held position was inside the 50 m STANDARD radius on 11 qualifying fixes, at a pickup carrying venue_id VEN-YISHUN-RING with registered_pickup_points of 1, so the wrong-entrance route and the pin-ambiguity goodwill in POL-NS-03(ii) do not arise on this record and POL-NS-02 governs the arrival test.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on this record: the rider's locating message was sent at 12:22:22 and the driver answered 'ok' at 12:22:37 - fifteen seconds later, well inside the 120 second window in limb (b) - and then at 12:22:57, four seconds before terminating the trip, posted the colour and position of the car, so limb (b) fails and the clause does not apply regardless of the content of those replies.

No anti-farming or abuse footing exists on either profile: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 62, a rate of 0.016, so the POL-NS-07 branch - which needs 4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08 - does not trip and compensation is not withheld on that ground; and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, far below the threshold of 3 that POL-NS-09(d) reads.

The driver does not dispute POL-NS-01 limb (c): the derived dwell is a single in-geofence run of 95 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip, an 85 second shortfall, and no accumulation is available under POL-NS-06(i) because the trace shows only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1) and the only traffic advisory covering this pickup, EV-ADVIS-03202-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - the driver discloses that impairment and does not rest any point on it. The driver's submission is that the remainder of the record is clean - a truthful arrival, a truthful reason code, and a reply to the rider's message within fifteen seconds - and that nothing beyond the shortfall itself should attach to him.

ruling.explanation:
Outcome: the 4.50 SGD cancellation fee charged on TRP-03202 is refunded in full to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable. Both parties' submissions largely agree on the arithmetic, and the arithmetic decides the case.

Why the fee falls. POL-NS-01(c) runs the dwell clock from the driver's first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'I'm Here' tap. On EV-GPS-03202 that first qualifying fix is at 12:21:22 and the driver's only in-geofence stretch ends at 12:22:57 - one continuous run of 95 seconds, run_count 1, carried by 11 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with 100% coverage and no gaps. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (EV-TRIP-03202 platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which the derived STANDARD threshold block confirms), so the effective dwell fell 85 seconds short, and the driver terminated at 12:23:01 with no boarding event - 99 seconds into the wait. POL-NS-06 makes that shortfall a strict-liability refund: the fee 'is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. POL-NS-01 is therefore broken at limb (c), and POL-NS-07 cannot fix a payout because it operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; no compensation is payable.

Claims accepted and rejected. I accept the driver's account of arrival (limb (b), read through POL-NS-02, is satisfied) and the driver's point that POL-NS-05 does not fire: the fix at the arrival event's own timestamp is the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, well inside the 50 m radius and not more than 300 m from the pin), so the marker was true and no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) can be entered. I reject the driver's claim that limb (d) holds and the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is truthful: limb (d) requires termination at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, and the termination came 81 seconds before the 180-second period could have run. That rejection changes nothing, because the same shortfall that breaks the code already gives the rider the refund under POL-NS-06. The rider's further limb (d) argument succeeds on the same timing and is likewise not needed for the outcome. Both sides' concessions on POL-NS-06(i) are accepted: aggregation across separate in-geofence intervals is unavailable because the trace shows a single interval, and the only advisory covering this pickup, EV-ADVIS-03202-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) - both sides disclosed that impairment, and a missing advisory cannot lawfully be asserted to permit summing (POL-NS-06(i), POL-NS-09).

Facts that do not move the money. The rider's track places the device within 18.05 m of the pin on all 41 qualifying fixes, and the chat shows the rider announcing his position at 12:22:22, the driver replying 'ok' at 12:22:37 and posting his car's position at 12:22:57, four seconds before cancelling. Those facts are accepted as context - they corroborate that this was a premature cancellation rather than a rider who could not be found - but they decide nothing: the fee fails on the driver's own track (POL-NS-11), and under POL-NS-04 the driver's 15-second reply means limb (b) of that clause is not met, so it is not the ground of the refund. The counterparty statement ('the rider was nowhere near my car') carries no weight_multiplier, enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the POL-GEN-02(2) cap, and is in any event contradicted by the rider track; the driver's remark that he 'had another booking waiting' does not alter the arithmetic.

Confidence and escalation. The deciding facts (dwell duration, the termination and its timing, and the 4.50 charged) are carried by EV-GPS-03202, EV-TRIP-03202 and EV-FARE-03202, each COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no artifact is below 1.0 on the deciding facts. POL-NS-08(a) to (d) show no impairment: no clock skew at the arrival marker, no sampling gap (max_gap_sec 0.0, 56 fixes, rider track present), 3 chat messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, and a 4.50 fare line reconciling to the net figure. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires - no same-pair disputes (0 and 0), rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 of 62 completed trips = 1.6%, both limbs required). Confidence 0.95 is above the 0.70 floor, so the case is decided rather than held.

Referrals and amount. No clause-produced referral fires: POL-NS-05(ii) is not triggered because the arrival marker was true, and the driver-education item in POL-NS-01 attaches to the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome, which this record is not (the code recorded is RIDER_NO_SHOW). The refund figure of 4.50 SGD is read from EV-FARE-03202 (cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, every other fare line 0.00), and POL-NS-06 confines the refund to the cancellation-fee line. The monetary effect of 4.50 SGD is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold, so it executes on issue (POL-GEN-05); the rider is paid 4.50 SGD and the driver receives nothing.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
